name: glyphify
description: Custom glyph and color for the reply bullet and the user-message chevron.

replyGlyph.title: Reply glyph
replyGlyph.description: Marker opening each Claude reply. Type any character your terminal can draw, e.g. ● ◆ ★ ✦ » ❯ λ → or an emoji; up to 8 characters.

replyColor.title: Reply color
replyColor.description: Named ANSI colors follow the terminal palette, so they look right in macOS Terminal.app. Has no effect on an emoji glyph, which draws in its own colors.

userGlyph.title: Prompt glyph
userGlyph.description: Marker before a prompt you typed. Type any character your terminal can draw, e.g. ❯ › » ▶ $ λ → or an emoji; up to 8 characters.

userColor.title: Prompt color
userColor.description: Named ANSI colors follow the terminal palette, so they look right in macOS Terminal.app. Has no effect on an emoji glyph, which draws in its own colors.
